title: Ponytail: a Claude Code skill that asks "should we build this at all?" before touching the keyboard
description:
AI agents default to generating code. Ponytail makes your agent ask whether it should. Before writing anything, the skill forces it to reason like the laziest senior developer in the room — the one who knows the best code is the code you never wrote. Can this be done by deleting something? Reusing what exists? Not building it at all? Less code, less surface area, fewer bugs. The senior-engineer instinct, bottled into a skill. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail

top_comments.author: @KeyboardWizardHimself
top_comments.text: This is borderline a hysterical joke and a legitimate breakthrough in vibe coding. I’ve been a professional dev for 20 years and nowadays I tell people things like “every line is a liability”. “How can we not do this” is the question that saves you from tech debt.
